sentences.text:
Shri Samar Ghuraiya - Public Prosecutor for respondent/S
 Order

The present petition under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the proceedings pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate First Class, Gwalior in Case No. 491/2005 which have been instituted in the year 1997 on the complaint filed by the respondent/complainant for the offence under section 7(1) and section 16(1)(A)(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954.
Since the present petition is of the year 2013, with the efflux of time, the same has lost its efficacy.
Considering the same, the petition is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE ojha Rohit Bhai Kanada, Asst. Manager, ... vs State Of M.P. on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196639436/
